channels.name: National Cybercrime Reporting Portal (India)
channels.what: The official Government of India portal for reporting cybercrime, including sexually explicit content shared without consent.
channels.who_decides: You. Traceveil never files a report for you.

channels.name: StopNCII.org
channels.what: Turns an intimate image or video into a fingerprint on your own device, and shares only that fingerprint with participating platforms so they can block it. Intended for adults.

channels.name: The platform's own grievance officer
channels.what: Larger platforms that operate in India are expected to publish a grievance officer and a complaint process. Look in the site's footer, help centre or terms.

channels.name: Your local police station or a lawyer
channels.what: If the content stays online, or you are being threatened, a police complaint and legal advice are the next step. Take the evidence report with you.
